introHtml: Cameo Novelty Corp carpenter pencils offer a reliable, classic shape that stays put on job sites and in tool belts. Unlike standard pencils, these flat-bodied pencils resist rolling, making them ideal for safety managers and contractors who need a stable marking tool. Choose from budget-friendly options or FSC® certified versions to align with sustainability goals. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or hot stamping for high visibility on the wide pencil face.
